states: Production vite build of this tree (rebased on c3adf0c7b9) embedded in a private DEMO_MODE mock backend (50 PVE nodes, 929 guests, 7 ESXi hosts), headless Chromium via Playwright; desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844.

Proxmox Overview guest table, Grouped layout: every grouped node row (8 desktop, 2 phone in the rendered window) is one td whose colspan equals the guest table's visible header count (8 desktop, 5 phone), with status dot, linked node name, cluster badge and Agent badge only; no data-workload-col cells, no PVE version, temperature or uptime text.
vSphere Overview VM table: the 7 host group rows render as one spanning cell (colspan 6 desktop, 5 phone) with host name and cluster badge, unchanged shape.

Bars and Trends metric modes both inspected: Trends adds four sparklines per guest row (Proxmox 140 to 560 images, vSphere 18 to 72) while each grouped host row keeps exactly its one status-dot image.
Screenshots of grouped rows in both modes and of open guest drawers inspected at both viewports; no page errors.
This is the shape both pages already rendered on main, where compactGroupHeaders was always set; it is not a check of host drawers, which both pages disable.
interactions: Opened the View popover (desktop) and the Filters popover (phone) and toggled Bars to Trends and back.
Clicked a grouped host row on each page: no inline node drawer row appears and nothing else changes.
Clicked the first guest row under a group on each page: its inline guest drawer opens.
Scrolled the first grouped host row to the viewport centre before each capture.
